page.layout: One page of text in a single column, a Hebrew-Latin dictionary with entries set one below another. No margin notes. Running head at top centre; page number at top right. Catchword at right below the last line.

main_text.p: Polluere, Inquinare. מְלוּכָּךְ Inquinatu, Pf.106. v.20. in R.Salom. הִתְלַכֵּךְ Inquinari. לְכְלוּךְ Inquina-tio, Inquinamentum. לְכְלוּכִית Idem.
לוּכְסָן · לְכְסָן Obliquum, Incurvum, Transversum, apud Talmudicos saepiùs. אֲלַכְסוֹן Idem. בַּאֲלַכְסוֹן Oblique, Per obliquum. Græcum est λοξὸς [?].

לָמַד Discere. הִתְלַמֵּד Studere. בְּמְלָאכֶת הַגִּיּוֹן הִתְלַמֵּד Stu-det in arte Logica. לִמּוּדִי Discibilis, Doctrinalis: Plural. לִמּוּדִיּוֹת Doctrinalia, Scientiæ, Artes: חָכְמוֹת לִמּוּדִיּוֹת Ar-tes disciplinales, scientiæ doctrinales: Artes Mathematicæ. תַּלְמוּד Doctrina, Doctrinale, Liber completens universum jus, & omnem scientiam Judæorum. תַּלְמוּד לוֹמַר Doctri-na vult dicere, Doctrina mens est. הִתְלַמְּדוּת Studium, Disci-plina, Joel.2.28. in Kimchi.

לִסְטִּי · לִסְטִים Latro, Sicarius, Prædo. Græcum est λῃστὴς [?]. Plur. לִסְטִין & לִסְטִין Latrones. לִסְטֵּס Latrocinari, Occidere, Interficere, more latronum, Hos.7.1. in R.Sal. לִסְטוּת Latrocinium, prædatio.
לָעַם Manducare, Mandere, Masticare: שְׁלוֹעֵס כֹּהֵן Qui-s masticat, Joel.1.6. in R.Sal. לְעִיסָה Manducatio, Masticatio.
לִפְנֵי Secundum, Juxta, Ut, Eo ut, לְפִיכָךְ Idcirco.
לָפַף Involvere: Hinc מְלַפְּפִין אֶת הַיּוֹלֵד Involvunt fasciis infantem, Ezech.19.4. in R.Sal. לִפּוּף Involucrum, Fascia.

לָקַר Vapulare, Percuti, Flagellari. Transferunt etiam ad solem, יִהְיֶה הַגּוּף לָּקוּי כֻּלּוֹ Erit corpus ejus percussum totum, id est, eclipticum, obtenebratum. לָקוּי לְקוּת Percussio, Eclipsis, Defectus solis vel lunæ. הַלְקָאָה Percussio, מִלְקוּת Flagellatio, sed specialis quædam, de qua vide præfationem in Abbreviaturas nostras.

page.notes: Hebrew and Greek forms are set in a small, worn type; the Hebrew vowel points and some Greek letters are only partly legible, so several Hebrew words are marked [?]. The Greek word after "Græcum est" in the λοξὸς and λῃστὴς entries is doubtful. A dark blotch covers part of the entry "לעם" (Qui-s masticat, Masticatio), and the Scripture reference "Ezech.19.4." is uncertain. The entry "לקרה" is hard to read in its Hebrew form. The reading of the page-head letter ל as a running head is an interpretation.
